findings.customer_surface: No build, review, tool, access-failure or internal-process narrative is present in the customer body. Sources and Korean confirmation date remain in one concise source section. Source text, screenshot overlays and tool observations are separately classified.
findings.facts_and_limits: All four base prices, photographs, photo-sample qualification and policy text match retained approved inputs. Unknown delivery total, time and facility acceptance remain conditional. No free shipping, guaranteed arrival, current stock, on-site installation, return collection, partnership, superiority or fabricated review claim was found.
findings.local_specificity: Green Funeral Culture Center is grounded in the retained government/operator address and telephone and the operator procedure that room confirmation follows placement. The copy explicitly separates facility contact from flower consultation. These limited facts do not prove current room allocation, receiving rules, 24-hour delivery or on-site expertise.
findings.originality_and_scope: The actual content is the already independently reviewed Bukgu text, with exact4-body parity. This review does not freshly compare every national sibling or certify absence of doorway risk. Product/policy overlap is expected; no old-region score or149/13/18-clause review schema is substituted.
findings.policy: Material mixing, regional rear-paper variation and no collection are preserved. FAQ keeps both completed-production and post-dispatch cancellation clauses without inventing a universal cutoff; distinguishes defective/wrong goods from seasonal-material differences; preserves late claim/address/refusal conditions and paid-order unavailability. Five original policy conditions intentionally omitted by the manuscript are still retained in original evidence and not silently rewritten.
findings.provider_voice_and_empathy: The seller helps choose a product and wording. Conditional uncertainty about expressing condolence is brief and respectful. No invented personal memory, emotion, fulfillment experience or price-based moral pressure appears. Repeated consultation verbs are noticeable but attached to distinct purchase decisions.
findings.purchase_intent: The regional home offers budget/ribbon entry and truthfully routes photographs to the Green detail. The detail answers which item, how it looks, base price, shipping-inclusive budget, ribbon wording, facility/room/timing, order information, changes and refunds.
